tool.name: bcftools_pluginimputeinfo
tool.description: Adds imputation information metrics to the INFO field based on selected FORMAT tags. Only the IMPUTE2 INFO metric from FORMAT/GP tags is currently available.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**bcftools_pluginimputeinfo**
Adds imputation information metrics to the INFO field based on selected FORMAT tags. Only the IMPUTE2 INFO metric from FORMAT/GP tags is currently available.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: bcftools/pluginimputeinfo - Container: biocontainers/htslib:1.22.1
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
